scripts.build: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build && cd .. && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');const root=process.cwd(),out=p.resolve(root,'dist');if(!out.startsWith(root+p.sep))throw new Error('Unsafe dist path');fs.rmSync(out,{recursive:true,force:true});fs.cpSync('frontend/dist',out,{recursive:true});"
